name: snRNA-seq of human optic nerve and optic nerve head - astrocytes
description: We identified 6 cell types/states of astrocytes from over 270,000 snRNA-seq cells derived from human optic nerve and optic nerve head

labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: We used scVI for data integration and then manually annotated each cell cluster with scanpy based on marker gene expression

labels.name: Astro_retina
labels.rationale: An astrocyte sub class that are primarly found in retina

labels.name: Astro_ONONH
labels.rationale: An astrocyte sub class that are primarly found in optic nerve head and optic nerve
synonyms: optic nerve and optic nerve head astrocyte glia

labels.name: Astro_ONH
labels.rationale: An astrocyte sub class that are primarly found in optic nerve head

labels.name: Astro_retina_NLGN1+
labels.rationale: An astrocyte sub class that are primarly found in retina and expresses NLGN1
synonyms: retina astrocyte glia that expresses NLGN1+

labels.name: Astro_ON
labels.rationale: An astrocyte sub class that are primarly found in optic nerve

labels.name: Astro_ON_AFF3+
labels.rationale: An astrocyte sub class that are primarly found in optic nerve and expresses AFF3
synonyms: optic nerve astrocyte glia that expresses AFF3
